text:
maya: Heads-up 10m sync: prototype for per-request decision trails. Goal: from any request row in the logs, operator can open a single pane that shows the switchover decision summary and link to full record. Thoughts?
jihoon: +1. two practical constraints: (1) don't fetch full payload for every row (perf), (2) need a stable decision_id that we can index. Suggest: show compact summary inline, and lazy-load full JSON on demand. decision_id should be opaque but sequential-ish: `dec-20260316-0001`.
anita: UI idea: inline badge "served: fallback" with an icon; click expands a micro-panel with three columns: reason, quick stats (latency delta, cost delta), and actions (open full audit, copy decision_id, flag). Keep microcopy short: "Rerouted for latency" vs "Rerouted for safety". Use different icons not colors alone so accessibility is ok.
ravi: Storage/telemetry note  we'll emit two events: decision_meta (compact) to the logs stream + decision_payload to decision-store. decision_meta is tiny (~200B). decision_payload kept per sampling config. Need API to fetch by decision_id: GET /decisions/{id}?view=compact|full. Auth: full view needs auditor role.
sarah: Billing question: if a request is downgraded to a cheaper model, product wants to know if the invoice shows original or served model. I'd prefer billed-on-served but product wants an audit column showing both. Can we add cost_estimate to compact summary so finance can reconcile?
jihoon: Yes. compact should include: decision_id, trigger_type, chosen_route, served_model_cost_unit, sample_flag. Example compact payload: ```{ "decision_id":"dec-20260316-0001", "trigger":"kv_cache_miss", "code":"CACHE_MISS", "chosen_route":"redwood-4b-quant", "cost_unit":"0.003" }```
manita: (typo) meant to say anita :)
anita: no worries :grin: Also UX: show a TTL on the per-request link (e.g., "audit link expires in 86d"). If archived, show an archive icon and link to request archive flow.
maya: retention defaults proposal: decision_meta 90d, full_payload 365d archived on compliance flag or tenant opt-in. Sample knobs: tenant-level sample_rate (0.1% - 5%) and a rollout-level override to fully capture during a canary.
ravi: important: operator overrides must not mutate original record. append override_event referencing original decision_id. We'll add an overrides substream so auditors can reconstruct timeline. CLI: `rictl decisions list --request <req_id>` and `rictl decisions get dec-20260316-0001 --view full`.
jihoon: Implementation nit: we should include a small human_message field in decision_meta so UI can render short sentences without hitting translations server: e.g., "Rerouted: model timeout > fallback model". Keep it under 140 chars.
sarah: For searchability: index decision_id, trigger_code, chosen_route, and tenant_id. Also surface a failed_to_fallback boolean when fallback itself errored.
anita: Microcopy variants for message UI: - "Response trimmed due to latency" (tooltip: we reduced tokens to meet latency) - "Content withheld for safety" (tooltip: we removed risky completions). Different iconography as discussed.
deploy-bot: Deployed: decision-store-migration v3.4 by jihoon  added decision_id index and compact view endpoint.
maya: Action items: anita to prototype the micro-panel and icons, jihoon to land compact/full endpoints + sampling knobs, ravi to draft retention defaults and operator override schema, sarah to draft billing reconciliation note for product. I'll collect feedback and put a short PRD in the rollout docspace by EOD. Thanks all :+1:
